title: Carbonda CFR 696 49cm Carbon Gravel Bike & Carbon Gravel 650b Wheelset
disclosure: The creator reviews their own frame bought from Carbonda; the description mentions no sponsorship or supplied product.
summary: Owner walk-round of a 2018-edition 49 cm CFR696 after about 2,000 miles of mostly road commuting: fit for a 161 cm rider, the about 7.9 kg build, handling, wheelset and the ordering experience.
